info.title: Syntra administration API
info.summary: Tenant administration and machine-token API for Syntra.
info.description:
The API the Syntra administration console itself uses, published so that
integrations can call it with a machine token.

Every operation names the permission it requires in `x-syntra-permission`
(every listed permission is required) and says in `x-syntra-token-allowed`
whether an API token may call it at all. A token is always the
INTERSECTION of its own scopes and its service account's roles.

Errors are RFC 9457 problem details (`application/problem+json`). See
docs/api/README.md for versioning, deprecation, idempotency and rate limits.

When policy requires approval for a bulk retry, nothing is retried: the answer is `202` with `approvalRequired: true` and the id of a new `bulk_retry` operation that a second person approves. The same caller submitting the same set within the same UTC minute gets that same operation back.

Requires `provision.manage`.

Sign-in is blocked at once, while target revocation is queued as a lifecycle operation and may wait for a second approver when policy requires it for an urgent departure. Administrators cannot offboard themselves.

Requires `identity.read` and `directory.read` and `provision.read` and `identity.write` and `directory.write` and `provision.manage`.

post.summary: Refresh a target system's stored entitlement catalog
post.description:
Reads the entitlements from the target and replaces the stored catalog.

Requires `provision.manage`.

get.summary: Search a target system's entitlements
get.description:
Live against Microsoft Graph for an Entra target (`source: "live"`), against the stored catalog otherwise (`source: "catalog"`).

Requires `provision.read`.

post.summary: Resume external writes to one target system
post.description:
Four-eyes: the administrator who paused writes cannot resume them (403 `four-eyes-required`). A recorded reason is required.

Requires `provision.manage`.

post.summary: Pause all external writes to one target system
post.description:
While a stop is active no connector write is attempted; reads, previews and evidence stay available. `expiresAt` may be at most 30 days away.

Requires `provision.manage`.

get.summary: Read a target system's daily connector health history

post.summary: Migrate a document-driven Entra target to the native connector
post.description:
Applies the migration the preview described. A target changed since the preview answers 409 `preview-stale`; one that cannot migrate answers 409 `migration-not-available`.

Requires `provision.manage`.

get.summary: Preview migrating a document-driven Entra target to the native connector
get.description:
Nothing is written. The preview carries the `revision` the apply must quote.

Requires `provision.read`.

get.summary: Read a person's manual account placement on a target system
get.description:
`placement` is null when the person follows the placement rule.

Requires `provision.read`.

put.summary: Move a person's account to a container and keep it there
put.description:
Records a placement that overrides the placement rule, then moves the account. A failed directory write still answers 200 with `moved: false`: the placement stands and the next run retries. An active write stop answers 409 `external-writes-paused` after the placement is recorded.

Requires `provision.manage`.

delete.summary: Clear a person's manual account placement
delete.description:
No account is moved here; the next run proposes the move back to the rule-computed container.

Requires `provision.manage`.

get.summary: Read a target system's account profile
get.description:
Answers 404 when the target has no account profile yet.

Requires `provision.read`.

put.summary: Create or replace a target system's account profile
put.description:
Templates that reference sensitive person data (such as `person.personalEmail`) are refused unless the request carries a substantive purpose for the disclosure.

Requires `provision.manage`.

post.summary: Preview the account a profile would render for a person
post.description:
Renders an unsaved profile against an existing person; nothing is written.

Requires `provision.manage`.

post.summary: Preview the container an account would be placed in
post.description:
Renders the saved container template against facts typed into a form rather than an existing person. Answers 404 when the target has no account profile.

Requires `provision.read`.

get.summary: Read a target system's current readiness evidence
List a target system's business rules

put.summary: Create or update a business rule on a target system
put.description:
An upsert: a body naming an existing rule replaces it. The condition is checked against the closed, depth- and size-bounded condition grammar, so a malformed leaf is a 400 rather than a rule that silently grants nothing.

Requires `provision.manage`.

post.summary: Preview which persons a business rule would match
post.description:
Evaluates the rule without saving it; nothing is written.

Requires `provision.manage`.

get.summary: List a target system's most recent provisioning runs

post.summary: Start a provisioning run for a target system
post.description:
Enqueues a background run that reads the target and plans its changes, and answers 202 with the `jobId`; the run appears in the run list once the job starts. Answers 503 when the job scheduler is not running.

Requires `provision.manage`.

get.summary: Read a provisioning run and its planned actions

post.summary: Apply the planned actions of a provisioning run
post.description:
Applies every planned action, or only those named in `only`. A run blocked by a safety threshold answers 409 `run-needs-confirmation` until it is sent with `confirm: true`; one blocked for a reason that cannot be confirmed away answers 409 `run-unconfirmable`. An active write stop or maintenance window also refuses the apply.

Requires `provision.manage`.

post.summary: Cancel a provisioning run
post.description:
A `previewed` or `blocked` plan is cancelled at once and its actions abandoned. A run still reading the target, or applying to it, stops at its next checkpoint — never between an action being sent and the target answering it — so the answer may be `requested`.

Requires `provision.manage`.

get.summary: List the built-in HTTP connector documents
get.description:
Constants shipped with the product; placeholders in them such as `{clientId}` are for the administrator to replace.

Requires `provision.read`.

post.summary: Test a target system configuration before saving it
post.description:
Opens a connection to the named host; a failed connection is reported in the response, not as an error. Rate limited per tenant and address (`AUTH_RATE_LIMIT_MAX` per minute, default 10).

Requires `provision.manage`.

get.summary: Get the tenant's settings

put.description:
Includes session lifetimes and whether console access demands a security key; enabling that is refused unless the caller's own session was established with one.

Requires `tenant.manage`.

get.summary: Get the tenant's branding
Get the current tenant deletion request and the deletion policy
get.description: Requires `tenant.manage`. API tokens are refused here (`403 token-not-accepted`); sign in as a person.

post.summary: Request deletion of the tenant
post.description:
Names a current offboarding assessment and a later export by digest; refused as stale if the tenant's data has changed since either.

Requires `tenant.manage`. API tokens are refused here (`403 token-not-accepted`); sign in as a person.

post.summary: Approve a tenant deletion request
post.description:
Four-eyes: the approver must be a different administrator, using a recently stepped-up session, within the approval window.

Requires `tenant.manage`. API tokens are refused here (`403 token-not-accepted`); sign in as a person.

post.summary: Cancel a tenant deletion request
post.description: Requires `tenant.manage`. API tokens are refused here (`403 token-not-accepted`); sign in as a person.

post.summary: Execute an approved tenant deletion
post.description:
Irreversible. Only after the cooling-off period and within the execution window, from a recently stepped-up session. The response carries the completion receipt, and is the only copy handed out.

Requires `tenant.manage`. API tokens are refused here (`403 token-not-accepted`); sign in as a person.

post.summary: Assess whether the tenant is ready to be offboarded
post.description:
Inventories the tenant's records and refuses readiness while a legal hold or unresolved lifecycle work exists. The assessment is bound to a SHA-256 digest and recorded as an audit receipt.

Requires `tenant.manage`.

post.summary: Download the tenant's portable data export
post.description:
A versioned JSON document, served as an attachment. Its SHA-256 digest is repeated in the `X-Syntra-Export-Digest` header. Secrets, credentials and tokens are excluded by construction.

Requires `tenant.manage`.

get.summary: Check for a newer release and read update progress

post.summary: Start updating the deployment to a newer release
post.description:
Accepted, not finished: the updater runs outside this process and restarts the server, so poll `GET /api/admin/update/status`. Refused with `409 update-in-progress` while an update runs, `409 updates-not-configured` without release configuration, and `422 not-newer` for a version that is not newer.

Requires `deployment.manage`.

post.summary: Roll the deployment back to the previous release
post.description:
Accepted, not finished; poll `GET /api/admin/update/status`. Refused with `409 update-in-progress` while an update runs.

Requires `deployment.manage`.

Refused for an account a directory source owns, whose next sync would overwrite the change.

delete.summary: Remove an authentication factor from an account
delete.description:
The response says whether the account's recovery codes were revoked with it, which happens when no factor remains to use them with.

Requires `directory.write`.

post.summary: Set a user's password on their behalf
post.description:
Ends the user's sessions and requires a change at next sign-in. Refused for an account whose password lives in a synced directory.

Requires `directory.write`. API tokens are refused here (`403 token-not-accepted`); sign in as a person.

post.summary: Issue a password-setup link for an account
post.description:
The link is returned, not mailed, and expires after 24 hours. It is a bearer credential: hand it over through a trusted channel.

Requires `directory.write`. API tokens are refused here (`403 token-not-accepted`); sign in as a person.

get.summary: Suggest the people an account might belong to
get.description:
An account that already has a person answers with an empty list rather than a conflict.

Requires `identity.read`.

post.summary: Reactivate a user account
post.description:
Restores the ability to sign in; sessions ended by deactivation stay ended.

Requires `directory.write`.

get.summary: List a user's active sessions

delete.summary: End one session of a user
delete.description: Requires `directory.write`.

post.summary: End every session of a user
post.description:
Also revokes the user's refresh tokens and sends back-channel logout to relying parties. Answers with the number of sessions ended.

Requires `directory.write`.

post.description:

Requires `token.manage`. API tokens are refused here (`403 token-not-accepted`); sign in as a person.

post.summary: Lift an account lockout
post.description:
Idempotent: unlocking an account that is not locked succeeds.

Requires `directory.write`.

bearerToken.description: A Syntra API token (`syntra_pat_…`), issued to a service account by an administrator. Acts as that account, narrowed to the token's scopes. Ignored when a session cookie is also present.

sessionCookie.name: syntra_session
sessionCookie.description: An administrative console session, established by signing in. Documented for completeness; integrations should use a token.

Problem.description: An RFC 9457 problem. `type` is a stable URI naming the failure (`https://syntra.dev/problems/<code>`); branch on it, never on `title` or `detail`. Some problems carry extension members with data a client can act on.

ValidationProblem.description: The problem answered when a request fails its schema: `type` ends `validation-failed`.

path.description: Dotted path to the offending field; empty for the whole input.

Page.description: One page of a list. `total` counts the rows matching the filters, not the table.

BadRequest.description: The request was malformed or failed validation.

Unauthenticated.description: No valid session or token was presented (`unauthenticated`).

Forbidden.description: The caller lacks the required permission (`forbidden`), the token's scopes do not include it, or the route refuses tokens (`token-not-accepted`).

NotFound.description: No such resource in this tenant.

TooManyRequests.description: Rate limit exceeded. `Retry-After` gives the seconds to wait.

Unavailable.description: The database did not answer within the transaction budget (`unavailable`). Safe to retry after a short delay.

Problem.description: Any other failure, as a problem.
